messages:
irene: quick heads-up — we're proposing an RBAC tightening for private deployments: remove cluster-admin from the deployer role and add a narrow keystore-decrypt role for onprem agents. need security + ops sign-off before we flip this in prod.
sam: can you paste the minimal role change? want to check audit implications and token scopes.
irene: yep — here's the diff i tested in a sandbox:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-decrypt
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["kms.redwood.io"]
    resources: ["decryptrequests"]
    verbs: ["create"]
```
leo: looks good. two notes: 1) we need to ensure audit logs capture request.subject and response.status on decrypt calls. 2) the onprem keystore agent currently logs to local file; we should ship to the SIEM over TLS before removing broad creds.
mira: +1. also concerned about network policies — the keystore agent must only talk to our HSM/VPC egress proxy on 10.8.0.5:443. if netpols block that incorrectly, decrypts will fail and apps could error open.
irene: agreed. proposed rollout plan: canary in eu-onprem -> observe decrypt latency/errors and audit entries for 24h -> ramp. fallback: re-add broad role and rollback netpols if alerts spike.
sam: any vuln context here? there was a CVE flagged in the keystore agent 2 weeks ago; is that patched in the onprem package we plan to deploy?
leo: triage summary — CVE-2026-1421 affects agent < 1.3.2. we patched in 1.3.3 and backported mitigation for 1.3.x-family in our private repo. recommend upgrading agents in canary hosts first and running smoke decrypt tests.
irene: thanks. also question for kms-bot — can we get an assertion that KMS audit forwarding is enabled for the eu-onprem cluster?
kms-bot: KMS audit forwarding: enabled for eu-onprem. Destination: siem-internal.redwood.local:6514 (TLS). Last verification: 2026-03-10. No dropped events in last 72h.
mira: let's also add an alert: whenever decrypt failure rate > 0.5% for 5m during the canary window, auto-suspend rollout and notify oncall.
oncall-bot: created alert: onprem.keystore.decrypt_fail_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> pager to #eng-oncall. playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-keystore-failures
sam: one more: audit retention — how long do we keep decrypt request logs in eu-onprem SIEM? compliance needs 1 year for certain customers.
leo: current retention policy for eu-onprem: 13 months for KMS audit index. If any customer requires longer we have a retention-extension workflow.
irene: great. i'll open a PR with the RBAC role and netpol, and tag sec/ops for review. plan to start canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. tagging @sam @leo @mira for approvals. :thumbsup:
sam: approving — will run smoke tests during canary window.
leo: approving from sec side, leaving a note in the PR about the CVE fix.
mira: approving for netpol changes, will coordinate with net infra for conntrack tuning if we see TLS session stalls.
irene: thanks all — i'll post the PR link when ready and include rollback steps.
